newsitem.title: USA: Investor has America First Financial stake.
newsitem.headline: Investor has America First Financial stake.

text.p: A New York investment partnership controlled by investor Daniel Tisch said Wednesday it has acquired 336,900 beneficial unit certificates of America First Financial Fund 1987 LP, or 5.6 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Tisch and Mentor Partners L.P. said the stake was acquired for investment purposes for $12.4 million.
Mentor said it acquired the stake in purchases made between May 9 and July 14 at prices ranging from $35.935 to $39.53 per beneficial unit certificate.
